'''Reeksa''' was a [[Carnivorous plant/Legends|carnivorous plant]] native to [[Iego/Legends|Iego]], with sharpened spikes for [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and deadly thorns along the length of their stalks.

==History==
[[File:Reeksa_root.png|thumb|left|180px|A reeksa root]]
Reeksa roots were necessary for the production of the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] antidote. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traveled to Iego to retrieve it. Whilst exhuming the root, the plant attacked the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but after severing two attacking heads, the pair managed to escape.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
It should be noted that after several of the plant's "heads" are cut off, they are seen to continue to bite as they fall.<ref name=":0" />

Originally, the [[Xandu/Legends|xandu]] appearing in the episode was to have been devoured by the reeksa vines.<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode018.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref>
